title: Achala Jewelry HIP-412 Metadata
description: An Achala is a piece of jewelry made of one or more Umiña NFTs (umina-achala-chain#16). The Umiña NFTs stay in the UA treasury, associated with the Achala by the MINT and TRANSFORMATION events. A gold nugget is a stone, so it can be an Umiña; the gold or silver of a piece comes from one of its Umiña stones or from an invoice in documents.

stone_id.description: The item ID, ACHALA-YYYY-XX-NN, for example ACHALA-2026-RI-01 (XX: the piece type, e.g. RI ring). Named stone_id like the Umiña one, since the HCS events key every item by stone_id.

umina_token_id.description: The Umiña token the stones are in (every stone is in the same token). The mint script fills it from UMINA_TOKEN_ID and refuses any other value.

stones.description: The Umiña NFTs the piece is made of, at least one, each by its serial in umina_token_id and its stone_id. The mint script checks each one exists, is held by the treasury, matches its MINT event and is not already in another Achala.

metals.description: The metal of the piece. Each stone_type is a metal from schema/stone-types.json. source umina: the metal is one of the piece's Umiña stones (e.g. a UA gold nugget), named by stone_id; source invoice: the refiner's or seller's invoice is in documents.

artisan_rna.description: Registro Nacional del Artesano of the artisan who made the piece

hs_code.description: Jewelry of precious metal 7113.19, of stones 7116.20 (to confirm, umina-achala-documents#1)

vendor_ruc.description: 11-digit SUNAT RUC of the seller of the piece; metadataValidator.js also checks its check digit

compliance_proof_hcs.description: Transaction ID of the COMPLIANCE event posted before the metadata was pinned (set by the mint script)
